jobs.title: See Our Interview Process
jobs.description: Recruiting | TrueAccord Skip to content Services First-Party Third-Party Compliance Collections Compliance Information & IT Security Licensing Compliance Resources Resources Collections & Compliance Press Blog Company Our Story Vision & Values Leadership Careers Contact Us Client Portal Contact Sales Services First-Party Third-Party Compliance Collections Compliance Information & IT Security Licensing Compliance Resources Resources Collections & Compliance Press Blog Company Our Story Vision & Values Leadership Careers Contact Us Client Portal Contact Sales Client Portal Contact Sales Received a debt collection communication from TrueAccord? → Click here for more information. Learn about TrueAccord’s hiring process. Our Interview Process 1 Review We review applications to look for relevant skills, experience, and values. For some roles, we’ll email additional questions or ask candidates to perform an exercise related to the role. 2 Recruiter Interview A recruiter will meet with you via phone or Google Meet to speak with you about the role as well as learn about your skills and experience. We are also happy to answer any questions you may have about TrueAccord and the team you’re interviewing for. 3 Assessments For certain roles, such as analytics and bilingual positions, we may ask you to perform an exercise to assess your skills. If a role is technical in nature, you may be asked to perform a HackerRank assessment. 4 Hiring Manager Interview Your potential team leader, or another related team member, will meet with you to learn more about you and to answer any questions specific to the team you're applying to join. 5 Interview Loop / Team Interviews After you have your conversations as detailed above, you’ll be invited to one-on-one panel interviews to meet with the team and other key people you’ll be working with. You may also get a chance to meet with a member of senior or executive leadership to talk about the culture at TrueAccord, and for them to learn about which values appeal to you the most. ** Panel/team interviews may be split into multiple sessions if availability is challenging. 6 Offer After a successful mutual assessment, we make an offer for employment. All offers are contingent on successful background checks. Most of our perks and benefits are applied on day 1 of full-time employment. Healthcare is always activated the 1st of the month after your start date. * Some interviews will be conducted virtually, while others will be onsite at our headquarters in Lenexa, KS. * The interview process may be delayed during any of these stages due to various reasons. We’ll always reach out to you in these circumstances to keep you updated on the process, but please feel free to follow up directly with your recruiter if you have any immediate questions. * If you reached out to us on LinkedIn, our support email, or another channel — thank you! We’re thrilled that you are so excited. Please note, regardless of your initial touch point with the team, all candidates are put into our Applicant Tracking System and follow the standard recruiting process listed above Frequently Asked Questions How long does your recruitment process typically take? For candidates who make it through our entire process, it takes approximately 2-6 weeks from the initial application, depending on the role. If we decide that we’re not moving forward with your candidacy at any stage, we’ll aim to let you know within a few days. 2-6 weeks may seem like a long time; this is because: We want to ensure we find the right candidate for the role We request background checks and personal references for all candidates who are offered a job with TrueAccord, which can take up to 14 business days to clear What countries do you accept applicants from? We currently only hire US-based employees with very few exceptions, limited to Canadian applicants. For further information, please reach out to our recruitment team by emailing recruiting@trueaccord.com . What are some tips for a successful interview? TrueAccord uses Google Meet and Slack for daily communications. For remote positions, we interview all candidates via Google Meet, we recommend all candidates have it set up prior to your interview (don’t worry, it’s free). For virtual interviews we expect candidates to turn their video on during the interview, so please let us know if you’re unable to do so. Be on time for your interview and make sure you’re in a quiet space with no potential distractions. Do your research about the role you’re applying for as well as TrueAccord as a product and a company. We have many resources available to help you learn about our product and culture which our recruiters will send to you during the interview preparation process. Interested in working at TrueAccord? See how we’re different. See all positions TrueAccord is a full-service digital-first debt collection agency. TrueAccord SMS Terms of Service Welcome to text messaging with TrueAccord, a debt collector. We send text messages to the phone number provided by our client, the current creditor, in the placement file associated with an account in our office for collection. If you are not the individual associated with the account, please respond WRONG NUMBER, email support@trueaccord.com , or call our office at 1-(888) 316-5474. You can choose to opt-out of SMS at any time by replying “STOP” to any SMS, by emailing “stop texting me” or something similar along with the phone number we are texting and your TrueAccord account number to support@trueaccord.com , or by calling our office at 1-(888) 316-5474 and informing us that you want to opt-out of SMS. If you opted in to text by speaking with one of our agents, sending in an email, or sending START to our short code, you consent to receive SMS messages from TrueAccord, our agents, representatives, employees, affiliates, or anyone texting on our behalf. You certify, represent and warrant that you are permitted to receive communications at any telephone number you have provided to the creditor of your account, to a prior debt collector or servicer, or to TrueAccord. You further agree to promptly alert TrueAccord in the event you stop using a particular telephone number. By not opting-out, you give TrueAccord permission to send account related text messages, such as payment reminders, resolution options, and other account information to the cell phone number on file. Text messages may contain a hyperlink to an individualized page allowing you to perform various self-service options. You agree to inform TrueAccord of any shared telephone number in which you do not consent to messages being sent. Message and data rates may apply. If you have questions about your text plan or data plan, please contact your wireless provider. TrueAccord is a full-service digital-first debt collection agency. Responsible Disclosure Policy At TrueAccord, the security of our infrastructure is a top priority. We recognize the vital role that independent security researchers play in keeping the digital ecosystem safe. This policy outlines our commitment to coordinating with the security community and provides a “Safe Harbor” for researchers acting in good faith. 1. Reporting a Vulnerability If you believe you have discovered a potential security vulnerability in a TrueAccord product or our infrastructure, please submit a report to security@trueaccord.com . Your report should include: A detailed description of the vulnerability and its potential impact. Step-by-step instructions (or a Proof of Concept script) to reproduce the issue. The specific URL, IP address, or endpoint affected. Your contact information for follow-up communications. 2. Our Commitment If you follow this policy, we will: Acknowledge receipt of your report within 3 business days. Work to validate and remediate the issue in a timely manner. Maintain open communication regarding the status of your report. Not pursue legal action against you, provided you adhere to the guidelines below. 3. Guidelines and Restrictions To remain in compliance with this policy and qualify for Safe Harbor, you must: Avoid Privacy Violations: Do not access, modify, or delete data belonging to TrueAccord clients or their consumers. No Service Disruption: Do not perform Denial of Service (DoS/DDoS) attacks or use automated scanners that may impact system performance. Confidentiality: Do not disclose vulnerability details to third parties or the public until TrueAccord has addressed the issue and provided explicit written consent. Legality: Abide by all applicable laws, including the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA) and state equivalents. 4. Safe Harbor TrueAccord considers security research conducted under this policy to be “authorized” access under relevant anti-hacking laws. We will not initiate legal action against researchers for accidental, good-faith violations of this policy, provided they immediately cease activity and notify us upon discovery of a sensitive data exposure. TrueAccord is a full-service digital-first debt collection agency.
